isolation: new research directory; read-only child sessions; no factory simulation or production B access

stages.design: 4 decision-critical claims, each independently checked by source audit, active falsification, transfer audit

reserve_policy: Only necessary evidence repair or failed-session recovery; no silent expansion; preserve all original votes and failures.
cost_note: Session count is not model-inference count. Each child may contain multiple model and tool turns. Owner read/search/coordination is separately logged and outside child-session cap. Monetary cost and final tokens are unknown before execution; do not extrapolate from historical cached usage.
evidence_policy: Actual primary-source reading plus disconfirming searches. Three model checks are not three independent sources. Synthesis and independent review are separate sessions.
context_policy: No inherited whole conversation or whole previous dossier. Compact sanitized internal brief, one research question/source family/claim per child; preserve primary-source pointers and necessary anchors. No raw factory records or secrets in web queries.
implementation_note: Existing CLI runner does not expose a reasoning-effort option; use an isolated per-stage CLI wrapper/config override and audit actual argv before dispatch. Do not modify the shared runner or account configuration.
